description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Icon' that renders SVG icons based on provided icon types or emojis. It manages icon dimensions and rendering logic, importing mappings and utility functions.

methods.name: getIconComponent
methods.description: Determines the appropriate icon component for a given icon type or emoji.

methods.name: isIconEmoji
methods.description: Checks if the provided icon type is an emoji by verifying if an SVG component exists for it.
